title: MaSIF designs binders for protein–drug complexes
summary: MaSIF designed proteins that recognize three complexes containing progesterone, venetoclax, or actinonin, then validated them in the lab. A venetoclax-inducible system activated the antitumor activity of CAR T cells in vitro; this is a proof of concept without clinical validation.

evidence.tested: MaSIF-designed binders were validated in the lab against three drug-bound complexes, and a venetoclax-inducible system switched on CAR-T tumor-killing activity in vitro.
evidence.unknown: The source states the CAR-T work is in vitro only, with no clinical validation, and binding sites are hard to predict.
evidence.ai_role: MaSIF generated surface fingerprints and searched for complementary protein surfaces to design binders.
